name: Map route
what: A trip: the start pin drops with its name, a dashed route draws in a curve to the destination with a plane (or a glowing dot) riding its tip and turning with it, the end pin pops with a ripple. A drawn map, or none over your own.
origin: travel / map routes - the template kinds marketplaces list (Mixkit, Envato Elements, Motion Array, Videohive), researched 2026-10-16
motion: camera eases out 12 %; pin back.out 12 f; route draws over 60 f (S-curve) with the plane on its tip every frame; end pin back.out 14 f, two ripples 22 f apart
